entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:1
segments: To every thing [there is] a season, and a time for every purpose under the heavens:

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:2
segments: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pull up what [is] planted;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:3
segments: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:4
segments: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:5
segments: a time to throw away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:6
segments: a time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to throw away;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:7
segments: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:8
segments: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:9
segments: What profit does he have who works in that in which he labors?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:10
segments: I have seen the task which God has given to the sons of men to be humbled by it.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:11
segments: He has made everything beautiful in His time; also He has set eternity in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God makes from the beginning to the end.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:12
segments: I know that [there is] no good in them, but to rejoice and to do good in his life.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:13
segments: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labor, it [is] the gift of God.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:14
segments: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever; nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God does [it] so that they fear before Him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:15
segments: That which has been is now; and that which [is] to be has already been; and God requires that which is past.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:16
segments: And again I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness [was] there; and the place of righteousness, that wickedness [was] there.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:17
segments: I said in my heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked; for [there is] a time there for every purpose and for every work.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:18
segments: I said in my heart concerning the matter of sons of men, that God might reveal them, and that they might see that they themselves [are] beasts.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:19
segments: For that which happens [to] the sons of men also happens to beasts even one thing [happens] to them. As this [one] dies, so that [one] dies; yea, they all [have] one breath; so that a man has no advantage over a beast; for all [is] vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:20
segments: All go to one place; all are of the dust, and all return to dust again.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:21
segments: Who knows the spirit of man [that] goes upward, and the spirit of the beast [that] goes downward?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:22
segments: Therefore I have seen that [there is] nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that [is] his portion; for who can bring him to see what shall be after him?
